purpose: Tested OpenDocument/open-format compatibility matrix for Archiv ingestion, retrieval, citation, and output (issue #37). Every family claim is re-verified by tests/test_format_matrix.py against live local ingestion runs; unsupported formats are rejected explicitly, never silently accepted.

families.detection: suffix plus bounded UTF-8 decoding; undecodable content fails closed
families.preview_render: the preserved bytes are the truth; any text viewer can show them
families.macros: none; content is never executed
families.encryption: no encryption layer exists; bytes are preserved verbatim
known_limits: line locators only; no paragraph or section semantics

families.detection: suffix plus PDF structure parsing via pypdf; malformed files fail closed
families.preview_render: LibreOffice render for report validation; poppler pdftoppm or pypdfium2 for bounded OCR rendering of textless pages
families.macros: embedded scripts and actions are never executed
families.encryption: empty-password decryption attempted; genuinely password-protected files marked pdf_locked without password guessing
known_limits: pages without native text yield conditional visual_ocr segments only when local Tesseract and Poppler tools are present (page, line, and pixel-region locators); with tools absent ingestion stays valid with no searchable text

families.detection: suffix plus OOXML package validation via python-docx; renamed or corrupt packages fail closed
families.preview_render: LibreOffice render inside the verified report workflow
families.macros: macros and active content are never executed
families.encryption: encrypted packages fail closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: text inside tracked insertions, content controls and field codes is not surfaced, and deleted tracked text is not shown; this matches the paragraph text python-docx reports. A table row wrapped in a content control is skipped and row numbering passes over it
a hyperlink written as a HYPERLINK field code rather than a hyperlink element has no target segment
footnotes, endnotes and comments are located by the identifier stored in the file, which Word normally, but not always, shows as the displayed number
text in text boxes, shapes and SmartArt is not surfaced

a Word document added before this reader existed keeps its older, paragraphs-only derivative until `archiv rebuild-derived <digest>` is run for it; rebuilding changes the derived document's hash, so citations already saved for that document stop validating (they fail closed)
heading levels are read from a paragraph's own outline level or a built-in Heading style it names directly; levels defined inside a style, or custom styles based on a heading style, are not detected

families.detection: suffix plus FIB (File Information Block) validation of the WordDocument stream; malformed or unsupported FIB versions fail closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; search and citations address extracted text segments
families.macros: only the WordDocument and table (0Table/1Table) streams are ever opened; a VBA project storage is never read
families.encryption: documents with the FIB fEncrypted flag set fail closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: character formatting, styles, fields, comments, tracked changes, and embedded objects are not extracted
table cell structure is not reconstructed; cell text is emitted as plain paragraph text

families.detection: suffix plus the {\rtf1 control-word magic; missing or malformed control structure fails closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; search and citations address extracted text segments
families.macros: this is a bounded plain-text control-word walk; embedded \pict and \object/\objdata payloads are skipped as opaque data and never decoded or activated
families.encryption: RTF has no native encryption concept; nothing is decrypted or password-handled
known_limits: font/colour/style tables, document info, headers/footers, footnotes, field codes, and index/TOC entries are treated as non-body and dropped
character formatting, tables, and embedded objects are not reconstructed
a \uN Unicode escape's replacement run is only correctly skipped when it is a plain character or \'hh escape, not a nested control word

families.detection: suffix plus OOXML package validation via openpyxl; renamed or corrupt packages fail closed
families.preview_render: LibreOffice render inside the verified report workflow
families.macros: formulas are never calculated or executed; the result the file stored for a formula is indexed and the formula text is kept in the locator
families.encryption: encrypted packages fail closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: a formula whose result was never saved in the file (for example one written by a library rather than a spreadsheet application) is indexed as its formula text, and its locator says the result was not saved in the file; Archiv does not calculate it
a data-table formula stores no formula text of its own, so only its stored result is indexed
the values and category labels a chart plots are not surfaced from the chart; they normally also appear in cells. Images, shapes, text boxes, comments and pivot state are not surfaced
number and date formatting is not applied: the stored value is indexed as stored, so a cell showing 25% is indexed as 0.25, and a date as 2024-01-31 00:00:00 rather than as the sheet displays it
a chart series named only by a cell reference, with no saved copy of the name, contributes no series name

worksheet bounds include actual stored cells even when declared dimensions are too small or absent; declared or actual rectangles beyond the cell position budget are refused before iteration; inconsistent row/cell coordinates are refused
hidden content is indexed and marked, not withheld: every segment from a hidden sheet, row or column carries `hidden`

a workbook added before this reader existed keeps its older derivative, with formula text in place of stored results, until `archiv rebuild-derived` is run for it; rebuilding can make citations already saved for it stop validating
retrieval indexes each normalized cell or row segment independently; phrases split across cells may not match as one literal phrase

families.detection: suffix plus BIFF8 structure validation via xlrd; malformed workbooks fail closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; search and citations address extracted cell text
families.macros: xlrd parses the BIFF record stream directly and never opens a VBA project storage; macros are never executed
families.encryption: RC4/XOR-obfuscated workbooks fail closed during normalization (xlrd rejects the FILEPASS record); no password handling is attempted
known_limits: formula source text is not decompiled from BIFF tokens; only the last calculated (cached) value is extracted
formatting, charts, and pivot state are not reconstructed
retrieval indexes each normalized cell independently; phrases split across cells may not match as one literal phrase

families.detection: suffix plus OOXML package validation via python-pptx; renamed or corrupt packages fail closed
families.preview_render: LibreOffice render inside the verified report workflow
families.macros: embedded content is never executed
families.encryption: encrypted packages fail closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: hidden content is indexed and marked, not withheld: every segment from a hidden slide carries `hidden` = `slide`, and every segment from a hidden shape or from inside a hidden group carries `hidden` = `shape`
hyperlink targets, picture and shape alternative text, SmartArt diagram text, embedded objects and slide comments are not surfaced

the values and category labels a chart plots are not surfaced; a chart series named only by a cell reference, with no saved copy of the name, contributes no series name; a chart whose link points outside the file is skipped, and nothing outside the file is read

speaker notes are read from the top-level text shapes on each slide's notes page; a group or table on a notes page is not read, and a hidden shape there is not marked. The notes page's slide image, slide number, date, header and footer are skipped. Speaker notes timing, animation and transition order are not surfaced

a presentation added before this reader existed keeps its older derivative, without tables, charts, grouped shapes or speaker notes, until `archiv rebuild-derived` is run for it; rebuilding can make citations already saved for it stop validating
retrieval indexes each shape, table cell and notes segment independently; phrases split across shapes or cells may not match as one literal phrase

families.detection: suffix plus bounded record-tree validation of the PowerPoint Document stream; malformed or truncated records fail closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; search and citations address extracted text segments
families.macros: only the PowerPoint Document stream is ever opened; a VBA project storage is never read
families.encryption: a CryptSession10Container record anywhere in the stream fails closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: slide and shape numbers follow record-encounter order, not resolved SlideListWithText persist IDs, so numbering may not exactly match the authoring application's slide order for edited/reordered decks
speaker notes, animation, and layout/master formatting are not extracted

families.detection: suffix plus validated ZIP mimetype entry or flat-XML document mimetype; mismatches fail closed
families.preview_render: LibreOffice render inside the verified report workflow
families.macros: embedded scripts are never executed; manifest and content are parsed as data only
families.encryption: manifest-declared encrypted entries fail closed during normalization
known_limits: tables normalize as structured rows; a table nested inside a cell is refused; page geometry, frames, and styles are not reconstructed
hyperlink targets and footnote or endnote bodies are read from text:a and text:note elements only; a link or note represented by producer-specific field markup is not surfaced

a footnote or endnote is located by the identifier stored in the file, or by its 1-based position among notes of that class when no identifier is present; that position can differ from the displayed marker
comments and annotations are not surfaced, and a note class other than footnote or endnote remains inline rather than becoming its own structure

a text document added before this reader existed keeps its older derivative, without link targets or note structure, until `archiv rebuild-derived` is run for it; rebuilding can make citations already saved for it stop validating

families.detection: suffix plus validated ZIP mimetype entry or flat-XML document mimetype; mismatches fail closed
families.preview_render: LibreOffice render inside the verified report workflow
families.macros: formulas are surfaced with their expressions and never executed
families.encryption: manifest-declared encrypted entries fail closed during normalization
known_limits: charts and pivot state are not reconstructed
hidden sheet state uses styles declared directly in content.xml; styles.xml and inherited styles are not resolved
hidden content is indexed and marked, not withheld: every segment from a hidden sheet, row or column carries `hidden`

merged-range state is read from the anchor cell; a repeated row or column that also declares a span is refused rather than expanded into overlapping ranges, and a hyperlink attached to a covered cell is not read
formulas are surfaced with their expressions and never executed; a formula-only cell with no stored display value is indexed as its formula text
retrieval indexes each normalized cell or row segment independently; phrases split across cells may not match as one literal phrase

a spreadsheet added before this reader existed keeps its older derivative, without merged or hidden state or link targets, until `archiv rebuild-derived` is run for it; rebuilding can make citations already saved for it stop validating

families.detection: suffix plus validated ZIP mimetype entry or flat-XML document mimetype; mismatches fail closed
families.preview_render: LibreOffice render inside the verified report workflow
families.macros: embedded content is never executed
families.encryption: manifest-declared encrypted entries fail closed during normalization
known_limits: chart content is limited to the title, axis titles and series names; plotted values and category labels are not surfaced, a series label without a resolvable cell address is skipped, and a chart whose draw:object is missing or outside the package is skipped
a flat-XML presentation has no embedded object part, so its chart content is skipped
hidden content is indexed and marked, not withheld: every segment from a hidden slide carries `hidden` = `slide`, and every segment from a hidden shape or hidden group carries `hidden` = `shape`
hidden state uses drawing-page styles and layer sets declared directly in content.xml; styles.xml, inherited styles and animation-driven visibility are not resolved
group nesting deeper than 32 levels is refused; a table nested inside a table cell is refused
placeholder roles are mapped from presentation:class; an unknown class is kept as written rather than guessed
speaker notes are read from top-level text frames; a table or group on a notes page is not read, and a hidden shape there is not marked
animation and transition semantics are not surfaced

a presentation added before this reader existed keeps its older derivative, without charts, groups, placeholder roles or hidden markers, until `archiv rebuild-derived` is run for it; rebuilding can make citations already saved for it stop validating

families.macros: embedded content is never executed

chart content is limited to the title, axis titles and series names; plotted values and category labels are not surfaced, a series label without a resolvable cell address is skipped, and a chart whose draw:object is missing or outside the package is skipped
a flat-XML drawing has no embedded object part, so its chart content is skipped

group nesting deeper than 32 levels is refused; placeholder roles are mapped from presentation:class; an unknown class is kept as written

families.detection: suffix plus validated ZIP mimetype entry; malformed math markup fails closed
families.preview_render: bounded text surface of the MathML source; source bytes preserved with their hash
families.macros: formulas are never executed or evaluated
families.encryption: not applicable; packages are validated ZIPs parsed as data
known_limits: the MathML source is preserved verbatim with its SHA-256; rendered equation images are not produced

families.detection: suffix plus validated ZIP mimetype and database content root; unexpected structure fails closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; object names are the inspectable surface
families.macros: embedded Firebird or other engine payloads are opaque binary streams that are never parsed or executed
families.encryption: not applicable; packages are validated ZIPs parsed as data
known_limits: table contents, queries, and forms are not extracted in this version; only bounded object names are searchable

families.detection: suffix plus native InPage100/InPage300 stream identification inside a bounded CFB container; suffix spoofing and unknown variants fail closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; search and citations address extracted text segments
families.macros: no embedded execution surface is invoked; the CFB container is parsed as data only
families.encryption: not applicable to supported variants; unparseable variants fail closed
known_limits: native searchable-text ingestion only; text_fidelity is searchable_best_effort
page geometry, frames, stories, columns, styles, and pixel-identical layout are explicitly not reconstructed (tracked separately)

families.detection: suffix plus image decode validation via Pillow; corrupt images fail closed
families.preview_render: the preserved image is the truth; OCR attests page/line/pixel-region coordinates when run
families.macros: no execution surface
families.encryption: no encryption layer exists
known_limits: without local Tesseract and language data, ingestion stays valid and produces no text segments (ARCHIV_OCR=off keeps tests deterministic)
OCR output is derived evidence with provenance and never overwrites the original

families.detection: XML header and SVG root element parsing; malformed XML, DTD entity expansion, or external references fail closed
families.preview_render: sandboxed resvg rendering when available; text elements extracted natively without external rendering
families.macros: script elements and external resources are ignored and never executed
families.encryption: no encryption layer exists
known_limits: complex path-rendered text requires optional deep-tier OCR rendering

families.detection: suffix plus RIFF/WAVE header parsing; corrupt audio fails closed
families.preview_render: no transcription in this version; playback happens outside Archiv
families.macros: no execution surface
families.encryption: no encryption layer exists
known_limits: audio transcription is deferred until a bounded local processor with evidence-backed acceptance tests exists
metadata (channels, sample rate, duration) is recorded for provenance

families.detection: suffix plus container signature and structure validation; path traversal and hostile entries fail closed
families.preview_render: member listing and recursive child document preview
families.macros: no execution surface
families.encryption: encrypted archives detected and marked archive_locked without password guessing
known_limits: archive recursion depth capped at 8
total aggregate expanded bytes capped at 128 MB
encrypted archives are recorded as locked and members are not extracted

outputs.verification: generated reports are reopened, structurally validated, citation-checked, and rendered before success is reported
outputs.notes: the report manifest pins exact source evidence and the DOCX SHA-256

outputs.verification: rendered from the validated DOCX through the local LibreOffice path during report validation
outputs.notes: requires a local LibreOffice installation; rendering is independent validation evidence
OpenDocument generation is not claimed in this version; ODF inputs are fully ingestible and citable

rejected_examples.reason: not a supported suffix; rejected before any parsing is attempted
not a supported suffix; audio support is currently limited to uncompressed WAV metadata

field_trial_decision.method: Rank only observed or explicitly confirmed gaps; do not add parsers without lawful fixtures and measurable user-work evidence.

ranked_next_work.reason: The real-world corpus contained rejected .doc files. A bounded native FIB/Clx parser (no sandboxed converter) is implemented and verified against lawful synthetic fixtures; real-world-corpus user-question impact has not yet been separately measured.

The real-world corpus contained rejected .rtf files. A bounded control-word plain-text parser (no sandboxed converter) is implemented and verified against lawful synthetic fixtures; real-world-corpus user-question impact has not yet been separately measured.
Field notes confirmed cross-cell phrase misses; benchmark row-aware retrieval before changing normalized-output or locator contracts.

ranked_next_work.format_or_limitation: InPage layout, columns, frames, styles, and page geometry
ranked_next_work.reason: Native searchable text is available, but the field trial has no lawful visual-ground-truth corpus for layout fidelity.

ranked_next_work.format_or_limitation: Difficult Urdu typography and layout OCR
ranked_next_work.reason: Conditional OCR exists; select recovery work only after language-specific accuracy and target-machine resource measurements.

ranked_next_work.format_or_limitation: WAV transcription and ODB record extraction
ranked_next_work.reason: Both formats preserve or expose bounded metadata, but neither has a measured local extraction baseline with acceptance thresholds and resource ceilings.
No measured field-trial demand exists; any future implementation must prove macros remain inert and validate the OOXML package without execution.
These are product workflows rather than parsers, and the field trial did not show that they outrank local ingestion and retrieval defects.
